headline: Anthropic bans sustained abuse of Claude; Gemini agents get Workspace seats
body: A lighter day that blurred the line between people and AI. Anthropic's updated usage policy, effective Nov 12, bars sustained, needless cruelty toward Claude without claiming it can suffer. Treating AI more like a party with standing nudges Human-AI Merging, lifting Descendants. Google gave Gemini agents their own Workspace accounts so colleagues can delegate to them like teammates, a step up in AI Autonomy. Horizon Balance held at -7.71.
movers_note: Descendants +0.3, mostly from the usage policy (+0.24) and Gemini agents' Workspace accounts (+0.09), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.09). Enslaved God -0.1, mostly from fading earlier news (-0.07) and Gemini agents' Workspace accounts (-0.04).
coming_up: Nov 12: Anthropic's updated usage policy takes effect
